```sql
SELECT CAST(ROUND(
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.items_ex_vat), 0)
       FROM orders o
      WHERE o.paid_at IS NOT NULL
        AND substr(o.paid_at, 1, 7) BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-03')
  -
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.refund_type = 'FULL'
                              THEN o.items_ex_vat
                              ELSE r.refund_amount / 1.1 END), 0)
       FROM refunds r
       JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
      WHERE o.paid_at IS NOT NULL
        AND substr(o.paid_at, 1, 7) BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-03')
) AS INTEGER) AS net_revenue;
```
